summary: Iteration 13 — frontend-only laser retest of the 3 UI bugs from iteration_12.json on the public preview URL. ALL THREE FIXES VERIFIED PASS. (1) PDP /products/test-it12-ui-variant-product: base shows ₹60 + ₹80 MRP + '25% off'; clicking 1kg chip updates [data-testid=product-price] to ₹110 and the unit line to '1 kg' with the MRP/off badge hidden; clicking 500g returns ₹60; deselecting restores base ₹60 + MRP + '% off'. (2) Cart line scoping: added the same product twice (500g/'NOTE A' and 1kg/'NOTE B') — 2 distinct lines rendered; '+' on line 1 changed only line 1 (qty 2 vs 1, total ₹200→₹260); remove on line 1 left line 2 intact in DOM and localStorage. (3) Zero 'Encountered two children with the same key' console errors on /cart; testids are unique (cart-item-<pid>::500g::NOTE A / ::1kg::NOTE B) and remove-<lineKey> works. REGRESSION: non-variant PDP (potato) shows base ₹25 and no variant-picker; single-line cart increment x2/decrement/remove works; cart total = sum(price*qty)+delivery (₹160+₹30=₹190 verified); fresh customer register → checkout → POST /api/orders sent items with variant_label='1kg' and note='CHK NOTE 1kg' (and nulls for the plain line), order created (#627D56), notify/order-whatsapp {placed} fired, cart cleared, order detail page shows variant badge + note. No console errors anywhere in the run.
